Field.name: InfoFile
Field.manpage: Name of a supermontage info file in which all data about files is be stored. It will be read in when the program starts, and renamed to filename~ before writing a new version when the program exits. If this option is not entered, the first non-option argument will be taken as the name of the info file.

Field.name: XRunStartEnd
Field.usage: Starting and ending frame number in X for patch files to analyze

Field.name: YRunStartEnd
Field.usage: Starting and ending frame number in Y for patch files to analyze

Field.name: ZRunStartEnd
Field.usage: Starting and ending Z value for patch files to analyze

Field.name: TargetMeanResidual
Field.usage: Target mean residuals to achieve in Findwarp (default 0.3,0.5,0.75,1.,1.25,1.5)
Field.manpage: One or more mean residual values to try to reach when Findwarp(1) searches for the best warping. Multiple values should be entered in increasing order. Findwarp(1) will try to find a warping with the largest number of included patches that gives a mean residual below the first value; then it tries again with the second value, etc. The default values are designed to produce a successful fit even with rather bad patches.

Field.name: ClippingPlaneBoxSize
Field.usage: Size of square area enclosed by 4 clipping planes (default 600)
Field.manpage: Four clipping planes will be added to the reduced and residual models to allow a small square of the patch vector model to be viewed in isolation. Use this option to change the size from the default of 600 pixels.

Field.name: ScaleFactor
Field.usage: Factor for scaling vectors in reduced and residual models (default 10)
Field.manpage: Factor for scaling vectors in reduced and residual models. The default is 10, is is used for vectors when combining tomograms. Note that the original vectors are always scaled by 5 in Edgepatches(1) because they tend to be so long.

Field.name: RescaleModels
Field.usage: Remake the reduced and residual models with the current scale factor.
